sources.fact: GET /domains/{id}: status, DNS records, sending capability and tracking flags.
GET /domains: limit/after pagination; list alone does not establish readiness.

One Full access key permits domain reads and sending; Sending access is restricted to sending. The app-credentials card accepts token and optional webhookSecret; no second sending-key connection is required.
POST /emails accepts one-recipient payload and custom headers; the response carries an id.
Idempotency-Key has a 256-character bound and a 24-hour retention window; durable OM dedup must outlive it.
Verify exact raw payload and Svix headers with a distinct signing secret before applying feedback.
Signed content is id.timestamp.rawBody; HMAC-SHA256 uses the base64 key after whsec_. Reject timestamps beyond the configured five-minute tolerance.
